script.problem: It has 2 sentences. Explanations are 3 to 5 sentences.

terra.problem: The verse says they will know He is the LORD; it does not state what God wants them to know.
“Nothing gets saved for later” conflicts with the weapons being used for fuel over seven years.
The explanation repeats the verse twice without adding a distinctive or helpful thought. It sounds flat and generic.
Achan is introduced without saying who he is.
“Nobody is rushing it” assigns an attitude the text does not give. “It takes seven months” also suggests the work is finished then, although the passage describes a subsequent search.
The passage says the person who finds a bone sets up a pillar; it does not say that person never digs anything.
“God tells Ezekiel” makes the quoted call sound as though it is addressed to Ezekiel. God tells Ezekiel to call the birds and beasts.
The timer joke treats the sacrificial feast of human remains lightly, on a card about a violent judgment.
The closing sentence merely repeats that the nations see what they see. The explanation is generic and flat.
Calling the suggested betrayal a “good plot twist” treats the serious subject of Israel's exile too lightly.
The explanation quotes God speaking as “I” without identifying Him as the speaker first.
“Nobody gets handed it” makes a broader claim about Magog than the passage supports. The verse simply does not promise it to Israel.
“The disgrace stops weighing on them” adds a feeling the text does not state or mark as Papa Dorin's own thought.
“No repeating” claims they will not repeat their treachery. The verse says they will forget it, not that they will never repeat it.
The two closing sentences restate details already in the quote without explanation or personality.
“You made it all the way through” assumes the baker's prior progress, which Papa Dorin has not been told.
